title: Missing moeb tool: Read for large start_run output
description: Used Read (Claude Code native) to read the start_run output that exceeded token limits and was saved to a Claude Code internal path. No moeb equivalent exists.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to support chunked or paginated output, or add a moeb tool for reading oversized tool-result files.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
